extraction_note: The source PDF's embedded text layer has a character-encoding artifact affecting the letter 'h' in some words (independently reproduced by two different extraction libraries, pdfplumber and PyMuPDF, so it is a property of the PDF's text layer itself, not a library bug). The raw extracted string reads 'the Primary Fund mid only been able' where the visible-page word is almost certainly 'had' (compare 'RMCI bas been registered' for 'has been registered' on p.8, and 'RMCI bad not' for 'RMCI had not' on p.33 para 115, same document). The verbatim_passage above silently corrects only this single, unambiguous OCR/text-layer artifact for readability; the dollar figures themselves ($24.6 billion / $10.7 billion) were extracted identically and unambiguously by both libraries with no artifact.
